permitted_scope: Source-image reprojection diagnostics for separable flat disk families; no motion or gravity scoring.
model: Nonnegative bilinear planar nodal density times exp(-abs(z)/h)/(2h), or thin sheet for h=0. Same basis is integrated over image cells along both axes.
interpretation: Heights are illustrative model alternatives, not independent measurements or posterior draws.
No best-height selection: all candidates, convergence failures and source residuals retained.
Input maps contain different native beams. Only an effective beam-blurred source is represented; no joint beam matching or deconvolution.
Coverage-weighted fitting is not a likelihood; partial native-pixel masks within coarse cells remain an approximation.
Fitted source light is evaluated on the same source data; these are closure diagnostics, not independent predictions.
The source axis, masks, support, penalty and gates are fixed before these source closure results; no velocity data are read.
Distance/conversion/geometry alternatives from generic-source-001 still apply; this first height pass uses nominal geometry only.
